source.label: McDonald et al. (2017), Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society 471 770-791

McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 59199: distance 14.937 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.002), at which the luminosity and radius hold

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from its measured spectrum. The disc itself is unresolved; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere.
controls.notes: The color of the star's measured spectrum (HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 105452). The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,039 K and log g 4.19 (u1 0.307, u2 0.333): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
